Shopping Tips for Expats

Supermarket Shopping

  • • Loyalty cards offer significant discounts
  • • Markets are cheaper than supermarkets
  • • Fresh produce best in morning
  • • Many stores offer delivery

Payment & Prices

  • • Most stores accept cards
  • • Markets usually cash only
  • • Bargaining common at markets
  • • Prices generally lower than Western Europe

Language & Service

  • • International chains have English speakers
  • • Learn basic Georgian numbers
  • • Google Translate helpful at markets
  • • Staff generally helpful to foreigners
